thesis: Following the simulation carry+MTM gap jump to 2026-09-01, pre-open news items are diffuse and dominated by generic financial advice, lifestyle articles, routine politician filings, and speculative crypto/IPO commentary (e.g. Shein debut challenges, MicroStrategy bitcoin buy, retail CD and factor ETF writeups). None of these headlines present a clear fundamental catalyst or sector rotation rationale for our portfolio. Our balanced mandate across broad equities (VTI), fixed-income ballast (BND), and technology sleeves (NVDA, XLK) remains well-structured, with 4 positions (cap 6), largest single name (VTI) at ~28% (under the 35% cap), and $35.00 cash (~32% of equity, comfortably exceeding the 15% floor). Holding all positions preserves cash and portfolio discipline without forcing trades on weak pre-market evidence.
